scheme_name: Assistance to General Farmers for Installation of Submersive / Centrifugal Motor Pumpsets With Accessories
other_conditions: Applicant must hold a minimum of 1.5 acres of land under the command area of the tubewell to be constructed
Applicant must have owned the land for at least 2 years and possess a clear ownership title deed in his/her name
The 1.5 acres of land may be in the name of the applicant, the applicant’s spouse, or a member of a joint/undivided family
Applicants who have availed a similar subsidy within the past 5 years are ineligible
Applicant must not convert the land for any purpose other than agriculture for 10 years from the tubewell construction date and must execute a bond accordingly
The tubewell must be registered with the Pondicherry Ground Water Authority
Applicant must obtain a mandatory permit for construction of a new or replacement tubewell
benefits_summary: Provides a 65% subsidy up to ₹50,000 per tubewell for installation of submersible/centrifugal motor pump sets with accessories.
